blank: Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is ___ hand!
usage: 現代英語仍用於較正式語境表示事情即將發生，如 help is at hand

blank: every tree that doesn't produce good fruit is ___ down
usage: 現代英語常用於字面「砍樹」或引申「削減」，如 cut down on sugar

blank: Jesus ___ about in all Galilee, teaching
usage: 現代英語常見於 go about doing something，表示著手處理某事或四處奔走

blank: You are the ___ of the earth
gloss: 社會中堅、樸實善良的人
usage: 現代英語常用來形容誠實可靠、腳踏實地的普通人，如 she's the salt of the earth

blank: let your ___ shine before men
gloss: 展現自己的才華或善行
usage: 現代英語常用於鼓勵人展現優點或善舉，如 let your light shine

blank: An ___ for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth
usage: 現代英語仍常用 an eye for an eye 表示以同等方式報復

blank: No one can ___ two masters
gloss: 同時效忠兩者、腳踏兩條船
usage: 現代英語常用於形容無法同時忠於兩個對立目標或陣營，如 you can't serve two masters

text: throw your pearls before the pigs
blank: neither ___ your pearls before the pigs
usage: 現代英語常用 cast/throw pearls before swine 形容把珍貴事物給不識貨的人

blank: come to you in sheep's ___
usage: 現代英語常用 a wolf in sheep's clothing 形容偽裝友善的壞人

text: built his house on the sand
blank: a foolish man who built his house on the ___
usage: 現代英語仍用來比喻基礎不穩固的計畫或關係，如 built on sand

blank: the Son of Man has ___ to lay his head
usage: 現代英語仍用 no place to lay one's head 形容無家可歸或無處安身

blank: why are you fearful, O you of ___ faith?
usage: 現代英語有時幽默引用 oh ye of little faith 調侃某人缺乏信心

blank: people put new wine into old ___
gloss: 新事物與舊制度不相容
usage: 現代英語常用 new wine in old bottles/wineskins 比喻新方法與舊體制格格不入，常見於商業與科技語境

text: wise as serpents and harmless as doves
blank: be ___ as serpents and harmless as doves
usage: 現代英語常引用 wise as serpents, harmless as doves 形容處世精明又心存善意

blank: ___ my yoke upon you and learn from me
usage: 現代英語仍用 take on someone's yoke 或 under the yoke 比喻承擔負擔或受人管束

blank: every kingdom ___ against itself is brought to desolation
usage: 現代英語常引用 a house divided against itself cannot stand 形容內部分裂必然導致失敗，常見於政治評論

blank: others fell on ___ ground
gloss: （想法或提議）未被接受、未生根
usage: 現代英語（尤其英式）常用 fall on stony/rocky ground 比喻提議或想法未被接受

blank: there will be weeping and ___ of teeth
usage: 現代英語常用（含誇張幽默用法）形容極度懊悔或抱怨，如 there was much weeping and gnashing of teeth

blank: having found one pearl of great ___
usage: 現代英語（尤其文學語域）仍用 a pearl of great price 形容極珍貴難得之物

blank: we only have here ___ loaves and two fish
gloss: 少量卻能奇蹟般滿足眾人的資源
usage: 現代英語有時引用 loaves and fishes 比喻資源奇蹟般地足夠分配

blank: Jesus came to them, ___ on the sea
usage: 現代英語常用 walk on water 比喻某人被認為無所不能，如 he thinks he walks on water

blank: if the ___ guide the blind, both will fall into a pit
usage: 現代英語常用 the blind leading the blind 形容能力不足者帶領同樣不足者，注定失敗

blank: I will give to you the ___ of the Kingdom of Heaven
usage: 現代英語（尤其商業/科技語境）常用 keys to the kingdom 比喻獲得最高權限或核心資源

blank: let him deny himself, ___ up his cross, and follow me
usage: 現代英語常引用 take up one's cross 比喻自願承擔困難或責任

text: gains the whole world and forfeits his life
blank: what will it profit a man if he gains the whole world and ___ his life?
gloss: 贏得全世界卻失去自我，因小失大
usage: 現代英語常引用 gain the whole world but lose your soul 形容為外在成功犧牲核心價值

text: faith as a grain of mustard seed
blank: if you have faith as a grain of ___ seed
usage: 現代英語常用 faith the size of a mustard seed 形容即使微小的信心也能成就大事，常見於勵志語境

blank: until ___ times seven
usage: 現代英語常引用 seventy times seven 比喻應無條件、無限次地原諒他人

blank: a certain king who wanted to ___ accounts with his servants
usage: 現代英語常用 settle accounts (with someone) 表示了結財務或了結恩怨

blank: he grabbed him and ___ him by the throat
usage: 現代英語仍用 take someone by the throat 比喻強勢威逼或掌控局面

blank: what therefore ___ has joined together
gloss: 神所配合的，喻婚姻不可拆散
usage: 現代英語婚禮中常引用 what God has joined together, let no one separate 強調婚姻的神聖不可分割

text: camel to go through a needle's eye
blank: easier for a camel to go through a needle's ___
gloss: 如駱駝穿針眼，極其困難
usage: 現代英語常用 like trying to get a camel through the eye of a needle 形容極端困難之事

blank: About the ___ hour he went out and found others standing idle
usage: 現代英語常用 at the eleventh hour 表示在最後關頭才發生或完成的事

text: the burden of the day and the scorching heat
blank: we who have borne the burden of the day and the ___ heat
usage: 現代英語（尤其文學語域）仍用 the burden and heat of the day 比喻長時間辛勤勞苦

text: not to be served, but to serve
blank: the Son of Man came ___ to be served, but to serve
gloss: 服務他人而非被服務，僕人式領導
usage: 現代領導學文獻常引用 not to be served, but to serve 闡述僕人式領導理念
